claim: Oura's API FAQ says the Oura API is free to use for both personal and commercial applications.
quote: Yes, the Oura API is free to use for both personal and commercial applications.

claim: API applications accessing more than 10 users require approval from Oura.
quote: However, API applications accessing more than 10 users require approval from Oura.

claim: A new API application is limited to 10 users until Oura approves it.
quote: By default, API Applications have a ten user limit. If you want to release your application to a wider audience, your application needs to be approved.

claim: There is no limit once an application is approved.
quote: There is no limit once an application is approved.

claim: Submit for review from the application's page.
quote: Once you have finished developing your application, you can submit it for review from the application's page.

claim: Oura's API returns 403 when the resource needs additional permissions or the user's Oura subscription has expired.
quote: The requested resource requires additional permissions or the user's Oura subscription has expired.

claim: Purchasing, activating and wearing a ring is the only way to unlock the membership's insights.
quote: Yes, purchasing, activating, and consistently wearing an Oura Ring is the only way to unlock access to all of the daily health insights that come with the Oura Membership.

claim: New members get their first month free.
quote: New members get their first month free.

claim: Oura's FAQ gives 5,000 requests per 5-minute period.
